name: Playground Settings
description: App-wide toggles for Playground presentation features. Today it drives the Open Order View on submitted Sales Orders (see playground/public/js/sales_order.js). Settings are shipped to the desk client through the bootinfo, so changes take effect on the next page load with no server round-trip per form.

fields.label: Enable Pending View
fields.description: Master switch. When ON, a submitted Sales Order shows the Open Order View panel (pending qty / pending value / completion). When OFF, submitted Sales Orders look exactly like stock ERPNext.

fields.label: Highlight Completed Rows
fields.description: Colour each item row in the Open Order View by fulfilment status (green = fully delivered, amber = partial, blue = not started, grey = cancelled/empty).

fields.label: Show Original Qty Column
fields.description: Also show the original ordered qty alongside the pending qty in the Open Order View. OFF by default so the panel reads as remaining demand.

fields.label: Show Original Amount Column
fields.description: Also show the original ordered amount alongside the pending amount in the Open Order View.

fields.label: Clamp Negative Pending to Zero
fields.description: When over-delivery or returns make pending qty negative, display it as 0. Turn OFF to show the true (negative) remaining figure.
